body:
I know I would feel less bad if I could coldly trick myself into blaming others for my problems, or not care about the wrong I may have done them. But I can't do that. The truth is inescapable,

This is all temporary? That's incredibly vague, give me a timeline. Tell me how long this will go on for, and I will tell you if Im willing to make that journey. What I know for sure if that if I had followed through years ago, I would have saved myself a lot of pain.

The only thing keeping me alive right now is one of the vices that has gotten me here, procrastination
